proposed.text: Under Section 1607 (2004 IRR), plastic skylights are proposed for a three-storey Type III commercial building in Occupancy Group E. What additional fire safety system is required for this installation?

options.text: An approved fire venting system from the Building Official, OR Type IV 1-hour construction with 400 mm curb, OR 1-storey building without a required fire-resistive ceiling — as alternative to suppression
Automatic fire-extinguishing system is always required regardless of construction type or occupancy, ensuring maximum safety
Type I or II construction is required for any building with plastic skylights, as these types provide enhanced fire resistance
A fire alarm system must be installed in all zones served by the skylights, to ensure early detection and response

proposed.rationale: The exceptions to the suppression requirement represent a design flexibility that architects can use when suppression is impractical. Understanding when each exception applies is essential for compliant skylight specification.
